transition guards split the slip-error space into four bands using `slp`

M1_guard_off_by_one.description: guard `>= N` mistakenly written as `>= N-1` (fires one cycle too early)

M2_wrong_transition_target.description: transition `A -> B` written as `A -> C` (wrong target state)

M3_unreachable_target.description: guard threshold set far too high (`>= 99999`), target state never reached

M4_missing_forced_transition.description: forced transition `! ...` line missing (global event ignored)

M6_wrong_effect_value.description: effect assigns wrong constant (`var = N` → `var = N+100`)

scenario_results.description: default-init with slp at the increase->hold boundary: first dispatches to increase outputs, then slp <= 0.01 transitions to hold neutral outputs.
scenario_results.name: default_init_increase_then_boundary_hold

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start in increase with slp just above 0.01 should not take increase->hold and should keep increase valve outputs.
scenario_results.name: increase_no_fire_above_hold_threshold

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start in hold with slp exactly 0.01 should not satisfy hold->increase because that guard is slp > 0.01.
scenario_results.name: hold_no_fire_at_positive_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start in hold with slp just above 0.01 should transition to increase and command inlet-valve increase outputs.
scenario_results.name: hold_to_increase_above_positive_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start in hold with slp exactly -0.01 should not satisfy hold->decrease because that guard is slp < -0.01.
scenario_results.name: hold_no_fire_at_negative_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start in hold with slp just below -0.01 should transition to decrease and command pressure-release outputs.
scenario_results.name: hold_to_decrease_below_negative_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start in decrease with slp exactly -0.01 should satisfy decrease->hold because that guard is slp >= -0.01.
scenario_results.name: decrease_to_hold_at_negative_boundary

scenario_results.description: explicit-hot-start in decrease with slp just below -0.01 should not take decrease->hold and should keep pressure-release outputs.
scenario_results.name: decrease_no_fire_below_negative_boundary

evidence: NL: states `increase`, `hold`, and `decrease` with outputs k1/k2/n.
DSL: state increase during sets k1=1,k2=0,n=0; hold sets k1=0,k2=0,n=0; decrease sets k1=0,k2=1,n=500.
DSL transitions match NL guards: slp <= 0.01, slp > 0.01, slp < -0.01, slp >= -0.01.
GroundingMap contains required states, actions, transitions, and guards with high confidence.
findings.summary: The DSL is faithful to the explicitly specified three-state hydraulic supervisor: increase, hold, decrease, their constant valve/pump actions, and the four slip-error threshold guards are represented directly.

Diagnostics include W_UNWRITTEN_READ_VAR for slp and W_UNREFERENCED_VAR for k1, k2, n, which are expected for input/output roles but remain advisory because role annotations are not explicit in the DSL.
findings.summary: Variable roles are not structurally separated in the DSL: `slp` is an external supervisor input while `k1`, `k2`, and `n` are pure actuator outputs, but all are declared as ordinary variables.
